palette_rationale: Keep the approved green skin, red crest, black-red eyes, tan outfit, wood club and pale teeth within the reviewed Idle palette.

ground_policy_note: Fixed grounded row-47 shadow; preserve native club arc, crouch and lift without per-frame recentering.

actions.name: Walk
